reason: The typed partial-application idea is not a completed reusable algebra. C16-C18 writes RELEASE,MODEL_YOUNG,REUSE(FORM1), but REUSE returns FORM_REFERENCE while RELEASE requires FORM; the stated reduction substitutes FORM1 without an explicit dereference or subtype rule. Context supply of omitted arguments does not license dropping a written expression. Three signature type names are absent from the type list, a documentary incompleteness rather than an impossibility proof. Preserve RAW as unexecuted; do not treat it as a failed native writer or silently fix it during adoption.

MATERIAL,FORM_BOUNDARY,FORM_REFERENCE occur in signatures but not declared type list. More fundamentally no native component/meaning bindings or complete target content operation are supplied. Completing documentation alone would not select a Voynich reading.

Keep the original RAW bytes and review limits. No existing confirmed lexeme is required, but arbitrary field/type labels alone are not native content.
